elevationSampleM.processingMethod: Nearest containing GLO-30 raster pixel sample; no interpolation or terrain metric calculated

provenance.provider: Copernicus DEM via AWS Public Dataset
provenance.processingMethod: geotiff.js remote COG range reads; nearest containing raster pixel; no interpolation

limitations: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public is a DSM, not bare-earth terrain.
One pixel is sampled; no slope, roughness, or neighborhood statistics are computed.
Product accuracy specifications are global statistics and do not guarantee local accuracy.
Atlas point coordinates are approximate; the raster sample must not be described as an exact site measurement.
Copernicus GLO-30 is a digital surface model (DSM), including vegetation and built structures; it is not bare-earth terrain.
